scenario: Grammar per LTAC.2.1 — a rule's RHS may carry trailing `after <duration>: <actions>` clauses. Pin: a rule with one immediate action and a single `after 5_min:` clause compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so LTAC.3.4's parent rule and `$<rule>_after_0` follow-up are not observed.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

rule auto_off:
    Motion m where m.state == true
->
    log info "motion seen"
    after 5_min:
        log info "5_min later"
